description: Expected results for the offline part of the official PyMT notebooks notebooks/frost_number.ipynb and notebooks/ku.ipynb (PyMT git, last changed in commit 4129aff; checkout c0544b6 = v1.3.2-3). Models come from the official pymt_permamodel 0.2.3 plugin (permamodel 0.2.3) with its own shipped default config plus the notebook's parameter changes. The 7 model values are taken FROM THE SAVED OUTPUT CELLS of the official notebooks (inputs/*.ipynb, execution_count given in 'why'). The notebooks print 8 decimals, so tol is 1e-7. FrostNumber now returns float32, which differs from the saved float64 print by about 3e-8 (inside tol). ku_soil_temperature_1 is not printed in the notebook; it is recorded from our own run (two clean runs gave identical values).
engine_version: pymt 1.3.3.dev0 (git c0544b6, v1.3.2-3), pymt_permamodel 0.2.3, permamodel 0.2.3, Python 3.12.3
